cases.prompt:
Extract at most 8 search-useful keywords or short phrases from the resume excerpt below. Prefer domain, technical, workflow, and product concepts. Exclude generic filler such as leadership, experience, team, stakeholders, results, communication, and collaboration. Return only the requested JSON.

Resume excerpt:
Experienced product leader with 15 years of experience leading cross-functional teams and working with stakeholders to deliver results. Built healthcare analytics products using FHIR and HL7 data, led product discovery with clinical users, and automated care-management workflows. Known for communication, collaboration, leadership, and a passion for improving outcomes.

Extract at most 7 meaningful technical or domain keywords from the text. Frequency is not importance. Do not return generic business words even when repeated. Return JSON only.

Text:
Leadership leadership leadership. Strategy strategy strategy. Teams, stakeholders, communication, delivery, results. The actual platform is a data reliability product built on Snowflake, dbt, Apache Airflow, and Great Expectations, with data lineage and data quality checks across regulated reporting pipelines. Leadership and stakeholder communication were important to delivery.

Extract at most 6 job-search keywords or phrases. Prefer specific compound concepts over broad single words. Do not return product, analytics, management, data, AI, or search by themselves. Return JSON only.

Text:
The role owns product analytics for an AI-assisted support platform. It includes retrieval augmented generation (RAG), vector search, evaluation pipelines, prompt quality measurement, and human-in-the-loop review. Product management and analytics experience are useful, but the important searchable concepts are the specific systems and practices above.

Parse the job posting into the supplied JSON schema. Distinguish required from preferred skills. Do not infer requirements that are not stated.

Posting:
Senior Product Manager, Clinical Data Platform. Remote within the United States, with quarterly travel to Raleigh, NC. Candidates need 5+ years of product management experience, hands-on work with healthcare data interoperability, and experience with FHIR. HL7 is strongly preferred. Experience with Snowflake is nice to have. This is an individual-contributor role.
